profile.headline: Staff Android Engineer at Tinder
profile.summary:
I build Android experiences and the platform infrastructure that feature teams rely on.

At Tinder, I’m a Staff Software Engineer on the Engagement Team, where I design extensible Android systems and infrastructure used by teams across the app. For several years, I was also the team’s sole Android engineer.

Previously, at Chewy, I designed the approach to move a monolithic Android app to 50+ modules and later provided technical leadership for a team of nine developers.

My work combines hands-on development, architecture, and technical leadership. I also mentor engineers and contribute to engineering practices and hiring.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Android
positions.description:
• Designed and built extensible Android infrastructure for Engagement, enabling other feature teams to plug in their own experiences.
• Served as Engagement’s sole Android engineer for multiple years, delivering experiences across the team’s roadmap.
• Lead technical planning across initiatives, shaping specifications, engineering decisions, and delivery quality.
• Contributed to Tinder’s engineering culture by proposing initiatives such as engineering working groups.
• Mentor engineers and help improve the engineering hiring process.
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Kotlin · Static Analysis Tools · Server-driven UI

positions.title: Android Tech Lead
positions.description:
• Provided technical leadership within a team of nine Android developers, guiding architecture, code quality, and delivery.
• Led the effort to bring native and web experiences together in the Android app.
• Mentored junior and senior engineers and promoted shared engineering practices through Chewy Architecture Components.

positions.title: Android Engineer (Freelance)
positions.description:
• Designed the migration approach from a monolithic Android app to an architecture with 50+ modules.
• Helped define and prioritize technology investments around business goals and user needs.
• Developed customer-facing features for Chewy’s Android app.

positions.title: Android Lead
positions.description:
• Led Android development for EduMe’s mobile learning platform, from architecture and implementation to testing and release.
• Incrementally refactored the app using Clean Architecture and reactive programming.
• Helped prioritize technical investments around product goals and user needs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Android
positions.description:
• Developed Android features for Sky Kids and Sky Q.
• Used pair programming, test-driven development, and continuous integration to deliver and maintain features.

positions.title: Earlier Experience: Android & Web Development
positions.description:
Built mobile and web products from scratch and led Android development across startups and established companies.

Selected accomplishments:
• Built Massimo Dutti’s first mobile app.
• Developed the medals app for the Sochi 2014 Winter Olympics.
• Managed Loodic, a mobile service connecting businesses with their customers.
• Built The Time Bird, combining Android time tracking with Drupal-based reporting.

projects.title: Massimo Dutti
projects.description:
One of the most incredible minimalistic and well designed apps for Spanish clothes manufacturing company, part of the Inditex group.

Still available for Smartphone & Tablet with a custom User Experience depending on the device.

projects.title: 2014 Sochi Olympic Games
projects.description:
App enables users to see real time events/medals/participants of Olympic Sochi Games of 2014. Entire off-line app.

(Not available in Play Store)
